description: Delegated admission (opt-in): a leaf bundle, its DCP-09 mandate chain and the bundle of every delegating agent, verified at one instant against the operator trust set, policy and revocation snapshots. Expected outcomes are written from the rules; agreement between SDKs is not the criterion.

cases.name: root_only
cases.rule: design 1.3: a chain of the root alone, leaf = the root agent

cases.name: principal_orchestrator_subagent
cases.rule: design 1.3: depth 1; mandate nonces differ from every bundle nonce (step 9)

cases.name: depth_two
cases.rule: design 1.3: depth 2 with two delegator bundles

cases.name: rotation_overlap
cases.rule: design 5: leaf signed by the new key, root by the old, both active in the trust set

cases.name: floor_maximum_reported
cases.rule: design 1.4: the floor raises the reported tier of a standard bundle

cases.name: open_limits_accepted
cases.rule: schema: limits is an open object; the preflight adds no constraint to it

cases.name: agent_key_rotation
cases.rule: design 5: the delegator signs with a key of its current passport

cases.name: floor_raises_weak_policy
cases.rule: design 1.4: a classical_only bundle the public API admits under a weak policy fails once the chain floor is elevated

cases.name: no_floor_weak_policy
cases.rule: design 1.4: the same bundle and policy with a chain without floor

cases.name: pq_only_stays_with_routine_floor

cases.name: root_algorithm_not_accepted
